description: Create a new A/B test. Returns the experiment ID, variant IDs, and SDK installation instructions. The installation snippet in the text block is what the agent should paste into the user's codebase. Variant IDs are server-assigned slugs (control, variant_b, variant_c, ...) — use those (not the variant names) when calling ship_winner later.

hypothesis.description: What you expect will happen and why.

metrics.description: Primary metric first. Secondary metrics track side-effects (e.g. pageviews alongside signups).

event_name.description: Event name the SDK will track, e.g. 'signup_completed'.

is_primary.description: First metric is implicitly primary if unset.

variants.description: Control first, then 1-4 test variants. IDs are server-generated (control, variant_b, variant_c, ...).

name: create_experiment
